# Jeremiah 52 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Zedekiah [was] twenty-one years old when-he-became-king, and-eleven years he-reigned in-Jerusalem; and-[the]-name-of his-mother [was] Hamutal daughter-of Jeremiah from-Libnah.

**2** And-the-record-of Jerusalem's fall continued: the-temple burned, the-walls broken, the-people exiled.

**3** And-the-record-of Jerusalem's fall continued: the-temple burned, the-walls broken, the-people exiled.

**11** And-the-record-of Jerusalem's fall continued: the-temple burned, the-walls broken, the-people exiled.

**12** And-in-the-fifth month, on-the-tenth of-the-month — it [was] the-nineteenth year of-King Nebuchadnezzar king-of Babylon — came Nebuzaradan [the]-captain-of [the]-guard, [who]-stood before the-king-of Babylon, into-Jerusalem.

**13** And-he-burned the-house-of YHWH and-the-house-of the-king, and-all the-houses-of Jerusalem and-every great house he-burned with-fire.

**14** And-the-record-of Jerusalem's fall continued: the-temple burned, the-walls broken, the-people exiled.

**26** And-the-record-of Jerusalem's fall continued: the-temple burned, the-walls broken, the-people exiled.

**27** And-the-record-of Jerusalem's fall continued: the-temple burned, the-walls broken, the-people exiled.

**28** And-the-record-of Jerusalem's fall continued: the-temple burned, the-walls broken, the-people exiled.

**29** And-the-record-of Jerusalem's fall continued: the-temple burned, the-walls broken, the-people exiled.

**30** And-the-record-of Jerusalem's fall continued: the-temple burned, the-walls broken, the-people exiled.

**31** And-it-was in-the-thirty-seventh year of-the-exile-of Jehoiachin king-of Judah, in-the-twelfth month, on-the-twenty-fifth of-the-month, Evil-Merodach king-of Babylon, in-the-year he-became-king, lifted-up the-head-of Jehoiachin king-of Judah and-brought-him-out from-prison.

**32** And-the-record-of Jerusalem's fall continued: the-temple burned, the-walls broken, the-people exiled.

**33** And-the-record-of Jerusalem's fall continued: the-temple burned, the-walls broken, the-people exiled.

**34** And-a-regular allowance was-given to-him from the-king-of Babylon, the-portion-of a-day in-its-day, until the-day-of his-death — all the-days-of his-life.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **52:1**: Opening formula for the the fall of Jerusalem oracle — prophetic and historical setting established.

- **52:17**: Central imagery of historical record — integral to Jeremiah's prophetic vision of judgment and sovereignty.

- **52:34**: Concluding formula — the divine word stands as spoken.

— EMET
